nav.note_zh: NAV green line: equity sleeve only (position_mv). Idle broker USD and BOXX are USD cash, not NAV units. Units change on equity ETF buy/sell only; FX does not change units. Shadow SPY/SSO mirrors equity trades only.

cash_usd_note: trades.json buys: cash debit = total_usd + fee_usd + other_fees_usd (principal vs fees explicit). cash_usd = broker wallet.

drawdown_reinvest.note: Peak/drawdown uses ETF position MV in TWD only. Cash USD/TWD from FX is excluded until deployed; set include_* true if you want cash in the total.

positions.note: BOXX position closed 2026-04-30; cash-like via broker USD if re-opened.

valuation.note: Current valuation uses Yahoo USDTWD=X close. portfolio.usd_twd_rate remains fallback only if Yahoo is unavailable. fx.json events are historical ledger records, not the live valuation rate.
